commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Andy Madley has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
88' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) picks up an injury.
87' The current number of offsides is 4:0.
83' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
80' Substitution. Yegor Yarmolyuk will be replaced by Mathias Jensen (Brentford).
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Reiss Nelson (Brentford) comes onto the pitch so that Kevin Schade can be given a rest.
80' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Joao Palhinha will be replaced by Mathys Tel (Tottenham).
76' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
73' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
69' Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Wilson Odobert as he is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham).
65' Igor Thiago (Brentford) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.
60' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
58' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Jordan Henderson (Brentford) duly receives a yellow card.
54' Dangerous play by Pedro Porro (Tottenham). Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
48' The game is interrupted. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' Andy Madley blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
40' It looks like Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) saw red with that tackle. Andy Madley won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
38' Flag goes up against Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
35' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
32' Richarlison (Tottenham) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards goal and it goes just over the crossbar.
26' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) commits a rough foul. Andy Madley stops the game and makes a call.
25' Brentford keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
19' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Rico Henry (Brentford). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
15' Tottenham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andy Madley blows for a foul.

7' Michael Kayode (Brentford) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Andy Madley with no other option than to blow for a foul.
6' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Kevin Schade (Brentford) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
5' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brentford will kick-off.
